sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sq(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN':
            cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            r0=min(rows)
            if r0<50: out[n['color']]=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return out
def beamtip(fr):
    rows=fr.ascii.split('\n'); best=0
    for r in range(14,40):
        for c in range(14,48):
            if rows[r][c] in 'wg' and c>best: best=c
    return best
print("BEFORE:",sq(current_frame),"tip",beamtip(current_frame))
res=action(['DOWN'])
fr=current_frame
print("AFTER DOWN:",sq(fr),"tip",beamtip(fr))
print("res",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sq(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN':
            cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            r0=min(rows)
            if r0<50: out[n['color']]=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return out
def beamtip(fr):
    rows=fr.ascii.split('\n'); best=0
    for r in range(14,40):
        for c in range(14,48):
            if rows[r][c] in 'wg' and c>best: best=c
    return best
print("BEFORE:",sq(current_frame),"tip",beamtip(current_frame))
res=action(['DOWN'])
fr=current_frame
print("AFTER DOWN:",sq(fr),"tip",beamtip(fr))
